Buy Dilaudid Online. Dilaudid is a derivative of morphine. Hydromorphone(Dilaudid) is bitter and hydrophilic like most opiates, not lipophilic, so it is absorbed poorly and slowly through mouth membranes. It is more soluble in water than morphine.
